episodes.title: I Spent Years in a Cult—Here's How I Got Out
episodes.description:
Drew Matthews spent years trapped inside a controlling church environment led by his own pastor father—an experience Drew describes as growing up in a cult.

In this raw clip from Beer, Booze & B.S. Episode 22 Part 1, Drew explains what life inside that world was really like, how difficult it was to recognize what was happening, and how he finally found his way out.

And this is only one chapter of Drew’s unbelievable story.
